concepts.label: Auditor Firm ID
concepts.doc: PCAOB issued Audit Firm Identifier

concepts.label: Auditor Location
Auditor Name
City Area Code
concepts.doc: Area code of city

concepts.label: Current Fiscal Year End Date
concepts.doc: End date of current fiscal year in the format --MM-DD.

concepts.label: Document Fiscal Period Focus
concepts.doc: Fiscal period values are FY, Q1, Q2, and Q3. 1st, 2nd and 3rd quarter 10-Q or 10-QT statements have value Q1, Q2, and Q3 respectively, with 10-K, 10-KT or other fiscal year statements having FY.

concepts.label: Document Type
concepts.doc: The type of document being provided (such as 10-K, 10-Q, 485BPOS, etc). The document type is limited to the same value as the supporting SEC submission type, or the word 'Other'.

concepts.label: Entity Address, Address Line One
concepts.doc: Address Line 1 such as Attn, Building Name, Street Name

concepts.label: Entity Address, Address Line Two
concepts.doc: Address Line 2 such as Street or Suite number

concepts.label: Entity Address, City or Town
concepts.doc: Name of the City or Town

concepts.label: Entity Address, Postal Zip Code
concepts.doc: Code for the postal or zip code

concepts.label: Entity Address, State or Province
concepts.doc: Name of the state or province.

concepts.label: Entity Central Index Key
concepts.doc: A unique 10-digit SEC-issued value to identify entities that have filed disclosures with the SEC. It is commonly abbreviated as CIK.

concepts.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each …

concepts.label: Entity Current Reporting Status
concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' whether registrants (1) have filed all reports required to be filed by Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that registrants were …

concepts.label: Entity File Number
concepts.doc: Commission file number. The field allows up to 17 characters. The prefix may contain 1-3 digits, the sequence number may contain 1-8 digits, the optional suffix may contain 1-4 characters, and the fields are separated with a hyphen.

concepts.label: Entity Filer Category
concepts.doc: Indicate whether the registrant is one of the following: Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Non-accelerated Filer. Definitions of these categories are stated in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most …

concepts.label: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
concepts.doc: Two-character EDGAR code representing the state or country of incorporation.

concepts.label: Entity Interactive Data Current
concepts.doc: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant has submitted electronically every Interactive Data File required to be submitted pursuant to Rule 405 of Regulation S-T during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that the registrant was …

concepts.label: Entity Public Float
concepts.doc: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as …

concepts.label: Entity Registrant Name
concepts.doc: The exact name of the entity filing the report as specified in its charter, which is required by forms filed with the SEC.

concepts.label: Entity Tax Identification Number
concepts.doc: The Tax Identification Number (TIN), also known as an Employer Identification Number (EIN), is a unique 9-digit value assigned by the IRS.

concepts.label: Entity Voluntary Filers
concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is not required to file reports pursuant to Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Act.

concepts.label: Entity Well-known Seasoned Issuer
concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is a well-known seasoned issuer, as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act. Is used on Form Type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 20-F/A, 6-K/A, N-CSR, N-Q, N-1A.

concepts.label: Local Phone Number
concepts.doc: Local phone number for entity.

concepts.label: Title of 12(b) Security
concepts.doc: Title of a 12(b) registered security.

concepts.label: Security Exchange Name
concepts.doc: Name of the Exchange on which a security is registered.

concepts.label: Trading Symbol
concepts.doc: Trading symbol of an instrument as listed on an exchange.

concepts.label: Adjusted Corporate Overhead Costs And Certain Other Income And Expenses
concepts.doc: The adjusted aggregated expense recognized in the period that encompasses corporate overhead costs and certain other income and expenses, as well as certain adjustments consistent with the Company's Adjusted EBITDA criteria.

concepts.label: Adjusted Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation And Amortization
concepts.doc: A non-GAAP measure defined as income from continuing operations before interest expense, net; provision for income taxes; depreciation and amortization expense; loss on extinguishment of long-term debt; asset impairment charges; gains or losses on the dispositions of businesses and assets; …

concepts.label: Adjusted Ebitda Acquisition Transaction And Integration Costs
also: Acquisition transaction and integration net costs
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of acquisition transaction and integration costs included as an addback to calculate adjusted EBITDA.

concepts.label: Adjusted EBITDA Addback, Other Items
concepts.doc: Amount of other items not separately defined that are treated as an addback to calculate Adjusted EBITDA

concepts.label: Adjusted EBITDA Addbacks.
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of certain items that are added back to us-gaap net income before tax to obtain a non-gaap measure called Adjusted EBITDA. This may include losses related to debt extinguishment, gain or loss on disposition of businesses and …

concepts.label: Adjusted EBITDA Asset Impairment Charges Addback
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of asset impairment charges included as an addback to calculate adjusted EBITDA.

concepts.label: Adjusted EBITDA Gain Loss On Disposition Of Business And Assets Addback
also: Adjusted EBITDA addback for net gain or loss on disposition of businesses and assets.
Net gain on disposition of businesses and assets
concepts.doc: Adjusted EBITDA addback for net gain or loss on disposition of businesses and assets.

concepts.label: Adjusted EBITDA Gain (Loss) on Financing Transactions
concepts.doc: The amount of adjusted EBITDA addback for gain (loss) on financing transactions during the period.

concepts.label: Adjusted EBITDA Restructuring Charges Addback
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of restructuring and other charges included as an addback to calculate adjusted EBITDA.

concepts.label: Debt Current Excluding Operating Lease Obligations
also: Short-term borrowings and current portion of long-term debt
concepts.doc: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt, excluding operating lease obligations, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument Net Of Unamortized Discount Premium
concepts.doc: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Deferred Charges and Other Miscellaneous Noncurrent Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred charges and other miscellaneous noncurrent assets not otherwise identified in the taxonomy.

concepts.label: Deferred Interest Payable, Non Current
also: Amount of deferred interest payable capitalized as long term debt.
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred interest payable capitalized as long term debt.

concepts.label: Deferred Share Value
also: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable deferred stock.
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable deferred stock.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets Deferred Financing Fees
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred financing fees

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Intangible Asset, Impact Of Swiss Cantonal Tax Reform
also: Impact of Swiss cantonal tax reform
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to impact of Swiss cantonal tax reform.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Intangible Asset, Impact Of Swiss Federal Tax Reform
also: Impact of Swiss federal tax reform
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to impact of Swiss federal tax reform.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan Expected Future Benefit Payments
also: Amount of future benefits from a defined benefit plan expected to be paid in total.
concepts.doc: Amount of future benefits from a defined benefit plan expected to be paid in total.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Interest, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible interest expense.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Interest, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to interest expense.

concepts.label: Impairment And Other charges.
concepts.doc: The total amount of other impairment charges, operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

concepts.label: Income Tax Valuation Allowance, Tax Benefit Likely To Expire
also: Valuation allowance, provision against tax benefit expected to expire
concepts.doc: The amount of valuation allowance provided against tax benefits expected to expire prior to utilization.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) In Income Tax Expense
also: The amount of increase (decrease) in income tax expense over the prior period.
Increase (decrease) in provision for income taxes
concepts.doc: The amount of increase (decrease) in income tax expense over the prior period.

concepts.label: Liquidity Amount
also: Amount of which the company has ability to meet its shortterm financial obligations.
concepts.doc: Amount of which the company has ability to meet its shortterm financial obligations.

concepts.label: Net Capitalized Turnaround Costs
also: Net capitalized turnaround costs as of the balance sheet date.
concepts.doc: Net capitalized turnaround costs as of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Number Of Manufacturing Plants
concepts.doc: Number Of Manufacturing Plants

concepts.label: Number Of Recycling Facilities
concepts.doc: Number of recycling facilities.

concepts.label: Number Of Research and Development Facilities
concepts.doc: Number Of Research and Development Facilities

concepts.label: Number Of Sites
concepts.doc: Number Of Sites

concepts.label: Number Of Sites In Which Entity Operates
concepts.doc: Number Of Sites In Which Entity Operates

concepts.label: Operating And Finance Leases, Combined, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating and finance leases, combined.

concepts.label: Operating And Finance Leases, Combined, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating and finance leases, combined.

concepts.label: Other Non Current Assets
also: Total of other noncurrent assets listed in the balance sheet.
concepts.doc: Total of other noncurrent assets listed in the balance sheet.

concepts.label: Payments of Acquisition Related Contingent Consideration
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the contingent consideration payments related to acquisition of business during the period.

concepts.label: Proceeds From (Payments For) Financing Costs
also: Amount of proceeds from (payments for) financing costs.
concepts.doc: Amount of proceeds from (payments for) financing costs.

concepts.label: Proceeds From Repayments Of Short Term Debt Excluding Lines Of Credit And Excluding Term Loans
concepts.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing, excluding lines of credit and term loans, having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, Other Segment Item, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of other expense (income) and loss (gain) calculated as difference between segment revenue and separately disclosed expense category to arrive at segment profit (loss).

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Percentage of Remaining Awards Cancelled
also: Percentage of remaining awards cancelled in a share based compensation arrangement.
concepts.doc: Percentage of remaining awards cancelled in a share based compensation arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Percentage of Target Awards Granted percent
also: Percentage of target awards granted in a share based compensation arrangement.
concepts.doc: Percentage of target awards granted in a share based compensation arrangement.

concepts.label: ShareBased Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award Options Expected To Vest Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Options expected to vest, Weighted average exercise price
concepts.doc: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on expected to vest portions of options outstanding under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Sharebased Compensation Arrangement By Sharebased Payment Award Options Expected To Vest Outstanding Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term 1
also: Options expected to vest, Weighted average contractual term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for expected to vest options outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Sharebased Compensation Arrangement Options Vesting, Number of Installments
also: The number of installments into which the entire exercise period is divided for vesting.
concepts.doc: The number of installments into which the entire exercise period is divided for vesting.

concepts.label: Time Deposits, Interest Rate
also: Represents the interest rate of the time deposit.
concepts.doc: Represents the interest rate of the time deposit.

concepts.label: Unrealized Gain Loss on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
also: Unrealized net (gain) loss on foreign exchange forward contracts
concepts.doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments

concepts.label: Accounts and Other Receivables, Net, Current
also: Accounts receivable, net of allowances (December 31, 2025: $10.2; December 31, 2024: $8.5)
concepts.doc: Amount, after allowance, receivable from customers, clients, or other third-parties, and receivables classified as other due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current …

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Other, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of obligations incurred classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Trade, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current …

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

concepts.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies
also: Accrued obligations for environmental remediation and restoration costs
concepts.doc: Total costs accrued as of the balance sheet date for environmental loss contingencies.

concepts.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all currently due domestic and foreign income tax obligations.

concepts.label: Accrued Liabilities and Other Liabilities
also: Accrued expenses and other current liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid nor invoiced, and liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

concepts.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital …

concepts.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
concepts.doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
also: Amortization of deferred financing fees and issuance discount
Amortization of deferred financing fees and debt premiums and discounts
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
also: Amortization expense related to finite-lived intangible assets
concepts.doc: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets.

concepts.label: Asset Impairment Charges
concepts.doc: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation
concepts.doc: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the …

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Current
concepts.doc: Current portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or …

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) asset retirement obligations.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
also: Obligations incurred and adjustments to estimated obligations
concepts.doc: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Settled
concepts.doc: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled, or otherwise disposed of, during the period. This may include asset retirement obligations transferred to third parties associated with the sale of a long-lived asset.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or …

concepts.label: Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

concepts.label: Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

concepts.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.doc: Fair value portion of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

concepts.label: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group
concepts.doc: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

concepts.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
also: Accrual for property, plant and equipment
concepts.doc: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalent
also: Cash and cash equivalents-end of period
concepts.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid …

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
also: Cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash-end of period
Cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash-beginning of period
concepts.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic …

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect and Discontinued Operation
also: Net change in cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change and including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, …

concepts.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified within 12 Months
concepts.doc: The estimated net amount of existing gains or losses on cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

concepts.label: Commitments and Contingencies
concepts.doc: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is …

concepts.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
concepts.doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
concepts.doc: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and …

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
also: Balance at end of period, shares
Balance at beginning of period, shares
concepts.doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value …

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation, including, but not limited to, long-term debt, lease obligation, purchase obligation, and other commitments.

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Cost of Revenue
concepts.doc: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
concepts.doc: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

concepts.label: Debt, Long-Term and Short-Term, Combined Amount
concepts.doc: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
concepts.doc: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Cash-Based Arrangements, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi …

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee benefits, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Other
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investment in Noncontrolled Affiliates
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries and investments in other affiliates which are not controlled nor consolidated.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, after Year Five for Next Five Years
concepts.doc: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in five fiscal years after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Five

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Four

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Discretionary Contribution Amount

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
concepts.doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

concepts.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

concepts.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]

concepts.label: Derivative Liability

concepts.label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Asset Offset
concepts.doc: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

concepts.label: Derivative Liability, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes derivative liability.

concepts.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
concepts.doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted

also: Effect of exchange rates on cash

concepts.doc: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent

concepts.doc: Amount of current and deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense

concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes finance lease liability.

concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes finance lease right-of-use asset.

also: Finance leases, Weighted average discount rate (in percent)

also: Finance leases, Weighted average remaining lease term (in years)

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
also: Remeasurement of foreign currency-denominated assets and liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
also: Gain on sale of other assets
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
also: Loss on extinguishment of long-term debt
concepts.doc: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Gross Profit
concepts.doc: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

concepts.label: Impairment, Long-Lived Asset, Held-for-Use, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]

concepts.label: Impairment, Long-Lived Asset, Held-for-Use
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
also: Equity in earnings (losses) of unconsolidated affiliate

concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Other Operating Liabilities

concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations incurred but not paid, and operating obligations classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Inventory, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt

concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities

concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.doc: Number of pending claims pertaining to a loss contingency.

concepts.label: Maturity of Time Deposits
concepts.doc: Period of time between issuance and maturity of customer deposits, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Long-Lived Assets
concepts.doc: Long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: Nontrade Receivables, Current
concepts.doc: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Number of Countries in which Entity Operates
concepts.doc: The number of countries in which the entity operates as of balance sheet date.

concepts.doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent

also: Operating leases, Weighted average remaining lease term (in years)

concepts.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount of operating loss carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of current assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
also: Net gain (loss) arising during period (net of tax of $(6.0), $2.2, $(3.0))

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax

concepts.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
also: Net gain on cash flow hedges (net of tax of $0.0, $(2.6), $1.3)
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax, Parent
also: Gain (Loss) Recognized in AOCI, Cash flow hedges
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax, Parent
also: Net gain (loss) on cash flow hedges, tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

also: Cumulative translation adjustments (net of tax of $0.0, $0.0, $0.0)

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
concepts.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
also: Total other comprehensive income (loss), net of tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Tax
also: Prior service credit arising during period, tax
concepts.doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
also: Amounts reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss)
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
concepts.doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
also: Accounts payable due to unconsolidated affiliate
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Receivables, Gross, Current
concepts.doc: Amount, before allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current
also: Accounts receivable due from unconsolidated affiliates
concepts.doc: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
also: Withholding taxes paid on restricted share units
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

concepts.label: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization
also: Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization Facility
concepts.doc: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
also: Proceeds from the sale of other assets

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
concepts.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation
concepts.doc: Minimum amount of purchase arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from a supplier.

concepts.label: Repayments of Lines of Credit
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

concepts.label: Repayments of Secured Debt
also: Repurchases and repayments of long-term debt
concepts.doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

concepts.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalent, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage, classified as current.

concepts.label: Restricted Cash, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

concepts.label: Restructuring Charges
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Restructuring Charges, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes restructuring charges.

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

concepts.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
concepts.doc: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price

concepts.doc: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
concepts.doc: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

concepts.doc: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
concepts.doc: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Options granted, Weighted average grant date fair value
concepts.doc: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
concepts.doc: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
concepts.doc: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
also: Increases related to current year tax positions
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
also: Increases related to prior year tax positions

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate

concepts.doc: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.
