concepts.doc: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
concepts.doc: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
concepts.doc: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Gross Profit
concepts.doc: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

concepts.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, before Accumulated Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
also: Net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders - continuing operations
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
also: Income (loss) from continuing operations before provision (benefit) for income taxes
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
also: Continuing operations, basic (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
also: Continuing operations, diluted (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming …

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Less: Income (loss) from discontinued operations, net of tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for …

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
also: Net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders - discontinued operations
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) …

concepts.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Accrued
concepts.doc: The amount of estimated penalties and interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
also: Income tax examination, penalties and interest expense (benefit)
concepts.doc: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
also: Effect of income tax rate changes on deferred items
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
also: Foreign income and losses taxed at different rates
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
also: U.S. federal income tax rate (benefit) provision at statutory rate
concepts.doc: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
also: State income taxes, net of federal benefits
State income taxes, net of federal benefits, and state tax credits
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
also: Adjustments related to uncertain tax positions
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Amount
also: Federal research and development credits, net of adjustments
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
also: Accrued expenses and other current liabilities
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Lease Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for operating lease.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
also: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Interest Expense, Nonoperating
concepts.doc: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

concepts.label: Interest Income, Other
concepts.doc: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation …

concepts.label: Investments
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
also: Less: Current portion of convertible senior notes, net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Marketing Expense
concepts.doc: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
concepts.doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Continuing Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities from continuing operations
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to continuing operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Continuing Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities from continuing operations
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to continuing operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
also: Net income (loss) attributable to Groupon, Inc.
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
also: Basic net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Long-Lived Assets
concepts.doc: Long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

concepts.label: Number of Operating Segments
concepts.doc: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the …

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Operating Expenses
concepts.doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
also: Present value of net minimum lease payments
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
also: Less: Current portion of lease obligations
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
also: Operating Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible List]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes current operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of current assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
also: Net change in unrealized gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
also: Accrued expenses and other current liabilities
Total accrued expenses and other current liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
also: Acquisitions of intangible assets and other investing activities
Payment for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
also: Taxes paid related to net share settlements of stock-based compensation awards
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
also: Purchases of property and equipment and capitalized software
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
also: Preferred stock, capital shares reserved for future issuance (in shares)
concepts.doc: Aggregate number of nonredeemable preferred shares reserved for future issuance.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
also: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
Total prepaid expenses and other current assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if …

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Convertible Debt
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
also: Proceeds from settlement of Capped Call Transactions
concepts.doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
also: Proceeds from sale of business, net
concepts.doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
also: Proceeds from Rights Offering, net of issuance costs
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
also: Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
also: Proceeds from sale or divestment of investment
concepts.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
also: Proceeds from sale of assets, net
concepts.doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds …

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
also: Total property, equipment and software, gross
concepts.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
concepts.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation
concepts.doc: Minimum amount of purchase arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from a supplier.

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, Due in Next Twelve Months
also: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. concepts.doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of a senior note instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of food purchases that will be consumed in the store operations.

concepts.doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Advertising Expense
concepts.doc: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

concepts.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Asset Impairment Charges
concepts.doc: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

concepts.label: Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

concepts.label: Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

concepts.label: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

concepts.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
also: Capital expenditures accrued in accounts payable
concepts.doc: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalent
also: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
concepts.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid …

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
also: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents
Cash and cash equivalents, end of period
Cash and cash equivalents, beginning of period
concepts.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic …

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
also: Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents
concepts.doc: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, …

concepts.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights
also: Exercise price of each right (in dollars per share)
concepts.doc: Exercise price per share or per unit of warrants or rights outstanding.

concepts.label: Commitments and Contingencies
concepts.doc: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is …

concepts.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
also: Cash dividends declared (in dollars per share)
concepts.doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
also: Par value of common share outstanding (in dollars per share)
Common stock, par value (in dollars per share)
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
concepts.doc: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and …

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
concepts.doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value …

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Construction in Progress, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

concepts.label: Cost of Product and Service Sold
also: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
Cost of goods sold (exclusive of depreciation and rent)
concepts.doc: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage
concepts.doc: Effective interest rate for the funds borrowed under the debt agreement considering interest compounding and original issue discount or premium.

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Revenue
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Inventory
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from inventory.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Domestic
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible domestic operating loss carryforwards. Excludes state and local operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, State and Local
also: State income tax net operating loss carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible state and local operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Self Insurance
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated losses under self insurance.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Inventory
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from inventory.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
concepts.doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

concepts.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
concepts.doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

concepts.label: Dividends Payable, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating …

concepts.label: Dividends Payable
also: Dividends declared but not yet paid
concepts.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Fiscal Period Duration
also: Number of weeks in fiscal year
concepts.doc: Duration of a fiscal period, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but not limited to, weeks in a year or quarter.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
also: Loss on disposition of property and equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
concepts.doc: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

concepts.label: General and Administrative Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Impairment, Long-Lived Asset, Held-for-Use
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
also: Total provision for income taxes (income tax benefit)
Provision for income taxes (income tax benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
also: Provision computed at federal statutory income tax rate
concepts.doc: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
also: State and local income taxes, net of federal benefit
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but …

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid
concepts.doc: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Income Taxes
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in current liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Employee-Related Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-Based Payment Arrangements
also: Nonvested stock awards and units and stock options (in shares)
concepts.doc: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating
concepts.doc: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
also: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation …

concepts.label: Inventory, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Labor and Related Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

concepts.label: Land
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depletion of real estate held for productive use, excluding land held for sale.

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Leasehold Improvements, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of additions or improvements to assets held under a lease arrangement.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Term of Contract
concepts.doc: Term of lessee's operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
Net cash used in financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Net cash used in investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
Net cash provided by operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Number of Operating Segments
concepts.doc: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the …

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
concepts.doc: Amount of loss from impairment of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
also: Total present value of operating lease liabilities
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Payments
also: Cash paid for amounts included in the measurement of lease liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Periodic Reduction
concepts.doc: Amount of periodic reduction over lease term of carrying amount of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
concepts.doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
also: Purchases and retirement of common stock
concepts.doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payments of Loan Costs
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

concepts.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
also: Taxes withheld from issuance of share-based compensation awards
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
also: Preferred stock, par value (in dollars per share)
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
also: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
also: Proceeds from insurance recoveries of property and equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
also: Proceeds from sale of property and equipment
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
