concepts.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Debt, Current
also: Short-term debt and current portion of long-term debt
concepts.doc: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
concepts.doc: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Debt, Long-Term and Short-Term, Combined Amount
concepts.doc: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Interest Carryforward
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible interest carryforward.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Capital Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible capital loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Asset, In-Process Research and Development
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Inventory
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from inventory.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
also: Net deferred tax assets after valuation allowance
concepts.doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Foreign
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign tax credit carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Postretirement Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from postretirement benefits.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
also: Deferred income taxes related to undistributed foreign earnings
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
also: Fair value of plan assets related to underfunded or non-funded pension benefit plans
concepts.doc: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
also: Projected benefit obligation related to underfunded or non-funded pension benefit plans
concepts.doc: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
concepts.doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

concepts.label: Derivative, Fair Value, Net
concepts.doc: Fair value of the assets less the liabilities of a derivative or group of derivatives.

concepts.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
concepts.doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common …

concepts.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
also: Exchange rate effect on cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to disposition of a business not …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to other reconciling items. Excludes state and local income …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
also: State income taxes, net of federal income tax effect
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

concepts.label: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to …

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition
also: Weighted Average Period of Expense Recognition (in years)
concepts.doc: Weighted-average period over which cost not yet recognized is expected to be recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for asset, excluding financial asset and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Loss, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized loss recognized in the income statement.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
also: Goodwill and Intangible asset impairment charges
concepts.doc: Total loss recognized during the period from the impairment of goodwill plus the loss recognized in the period resulting from the impairment of the carrying amount of intangible assets, other than goodwill.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount, before accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized. Includes amount, before amortization expense and …

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Accumulated Impairment Loss
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Gross Profit
concepts.doc: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Discontinued Operations
concepts.doc: Amount of current tax expense (benefit) and deferred tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations and income (loss) from discontinued operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
concepts.doc: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Gross (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated amortization of intangible assets, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating
concepts.doc: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation …

concepts.label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Net of Reserves
concepts.doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

concepts.label: Inventory, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves
concepts.doc: Aggregated amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

concepts.label: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
concepts.doc: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Letters of Credit Outstanding, Amount
concepts.doc: The total amount of the contingent obligation under letters of credit outstanding as of the reporting date.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Loss Contingency, Number of Defendants
concepts.doc: Number of defendants named in a legal action.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash used in financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash used in investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Number of Operating Segments
concepts.doc: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the …

concepts.label: Number of Reporting Units
concepts.doc: Number of reporting units tested for impairment of goodwill. A reporting unit is an operating segment or one level below an operating segment.

concepts.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
also: Operating Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible List]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes current operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Payments
also: Operating cash flows from operating leases
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
also: Total other comprehensive income (loss), net of tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
also: Income tax provision (benefit) related to AOCL
concepts.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
also: Payment for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for Restructuring
concepts.doc: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

concepts.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
also: Preferred stock, par value (in USD per share)
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
also: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
concepts.doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
also: Net proceeds from issuance of long-term debt
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
also: Equity compensation activity and other, net
Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt
also: Proceeds from (payments on) short-term debt, net
concepts.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
also: Proceeds from sale of divested businesses and investments
concepts.doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. …

concepts.label: Product Liability Accrual, Period Expense
concepts.doc: The amount of loss reported during the period pertaining to product liability.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Research and Development Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or …

concepts.label: Restricted Cash
also: Restricted cash at beginning of period
Restricted cash at end of period
concepts.doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

concepts.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date
also: Restructuring and related cost incurred since inception
concepts.doc: Amount of costs incurred to date for the specified restructuring cost.

concepts.label: Restructuring Charges
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Restructuring Reserve
concepts.doc: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized …

concepts.label: Restructuring Reserve, Translation and Other Adjustment
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the restructuring reserve related to foreign currency translation (gain) loss and other increases (decreases).

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

concepts.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific …

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Segment, Expenditure, Addition to Long-Lived Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of expenditure for addition to long-lived assets included in determination of segment assets by chief operating decision maker (CODM) or otherwise regularly provided to CODM. Excludes expenditure for addition to financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage …

concepts.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale …

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
concepts.doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Forfeited, weighted-average grant date fair value (per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
concepts.doc: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Granted, weighted-average grant date fair value (per share)
concepts.doc: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number
also: Restricted stock outstanding, beginning of period (in shares)
Restricted stock outstanding, end of period (in shares)
concepts.doc: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Weighted-average grant date fair value per share, outstanding, end of period (per share)
concepts.doc: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
concepts.doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
concepts.doc: Fair value of share-based awards for which the grantee gained the right by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Vested, weighted-average grant date fair value (per share)
concepts.doc: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, …

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
also: Options exercisable, end of year (in shares)
concepts.doc: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Weighted average exercise price, options exercisable, end of year (in USD per share)
concepts.doc: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
concepts.doc: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
concepts.doc: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
concepts.doc: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Weighted average exercise price, beginning balance (in USD per share)
Weighted average exercise price, ending balance (in USD per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other
concepts.doc: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

concepts.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation for supplier finance program.

concepts.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation, Settlement
also: Invoices paid to the third-party vendor
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in obligation for supplier finance program from settlement.

concepts.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation, Addition
also: Invoices participating in the SF Program
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in obligation for supplier finance program.

concepts.label: Supplier Finance Program, Obligation, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes obligation for supplier finance program.

concepts.label: Supplier Finance Program, Payment Timing, Period
concepts.doc: Period when payment is expected to be made to finance provider or intermediary in supplier finance program, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
concepts.doc: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Value
also: Treasury stock, at cost (27.9 and 26.2 shares at December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively)
concepts.doc: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

concepts.label: Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
concepts.doc: Amount of undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries intended to be permanently reinvested outside the country of domicile.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
also: Decreases in tax positions for prior years
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
also: Increase in tax positions for the current period
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
also: Increases in tax positions for prior years
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
concepts.doc: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

concepts.label: Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Increase (Decrease), Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for a specified deferred tax asset.

concepts.label: Variable Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
concepts.doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
concepts.doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been …

concepts.label: Auditor Firm ID
concepts.doc: PCAOB issued Audit Firm Identifier

concepts.label: Auditor Location
Auditor Name
City Area Code
concepts.doc: Area code of city

concepts.label: Current Fiscal Year End Date
concepts.doc: End date of current fiscal year in the format --MM-DD.

concepts.label: Document Fiscal Period Focus
concepts.doc: Fiscal period values are FY, Q1, Q2, and Q3. 1st, 2nd and 3rd quarter 10-Q or 10-QT statements have value Q1, Q2, and Q3 respectively, with 10-K, 10-KT or other fiscal year statements having FY.

concepts.label: Document Type
concepts.doc: The type of document being provided (such as 10-K, 10-Q, 485BPOS, etc). The document type is limited to the same value as the supporting SEC submission type, or the word 'Other'.

concepts.label: Entity Address, Address Line One
concepts.doc: Address Line 1 such as Attn, Building Name, Street Name

concepts.label: Entity Address, Address Line Two
concepts.doc: Address Line 2 such as Street or Suite number

concepts.label: Entity Address, City or Town
concepts.doc: Name of the City or Town

concepts.label: Entity Address, Postal Zip Code
concepts.doc: Code for the postal or zip code

concepts.label: Entity Address, State or Province
concepts.doc: Name of the state or province.

concepts.label: Entity Central Index Key
concepts.doc: A unique 10-digit SEC-issued value to identify entities that have filed disclosures with the SEC. It is commonly abbreviated as CIK.

concepts.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each …

concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' whether registrants (1) have filed all reports required to be filed by Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that registrants were …

concepts.label: Entity File Number
concepts.doc: Commission file number. The field allows up to 17 characters. The prefix may contain 1-3 digits, the sequence number may contain 1-8 digits, the optional suffix may contain 1-4 characters, and the fields are separated with a hyphen.

concepts.label: Entity Filer Category
concepts.doc: Indicate whether the registrant is one of the following: Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Non-accelerated Filer. Definitions of these categories are stated in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most …

concepts.label: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
concepts.doc: Two-character EDGAR code representing the state or country of incorporation.

concepts.label: Entity Interactive Data Current
concepts.doc: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant has submitted electronically every Interactive Data File required to be submitted pursuant to Rule 405 of Regulation S-T during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that the registrant was …

concepts.label: Entity Public Float
concepts.doc: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as …

concepts.label: Entity Registrant Name
concepts.doc: The exact name of the entity filing the report as specified in its charter, which is required by forms filed with the SEC.

concepts.label: Entity Tax Identification Number
concepts.doc: The Tax Identification Number (TIN), also known as an Employer Identification Number (EIN), is a unique 9-digit value assigned by the IRS.

concepts.label: Entity Voluntary Filers
concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is not required to file reports pursuant to Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Act.

concepts.label: Entity Well-known Seasoned Issuer
concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is a well-known seasoned issuer, as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act. Is used on Form Type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 20-F/A, 6-K/A, N-CSR, N-Q, N-1A.

concepts.label: Local Phone Number
concepts.doc: Local phone number for entity.

concepts.label: Title of 12(b) Security
concepts.doc: Title of a 12(b) registered security.

concepts.label: Security Exchange Name
concepts.doc: Name of the Exchange on which a security is registered.

concepts.label: Trading Symbol
concepts.doc: Trading symbol of an instrument as listed on an exchange.

also: Contribution related to formation of San Mateo, tax

concepts.label: Advances From Joint Interest Owners For Costs Incurred On Joint Interest Wells
concepts.doc: Amounts received from joint interest owners in advance of costs being incurred on wells in which they have a joint interest.

concepts.doc: Asset Acquisition, Acquisitions During Period

concepts.doc: Asset Retirement Obligation, Divestitures

also: Contributions related to formation of San Mateo

concepts.doc: Capitalized general and administrative costs.

also: Common stock and restricted stock unit expense
Common stock and restricted stock expense.
concepts.doc: Common stock and restricted stock expense.

also: Secured debt, percentage of mortgages used as security

concepts.doc: Decrease In Liabilities For Drilling, Completion And Equipping Capital Expenditures

concepts.doc: Deferred Tax Assets (Liabilities), Net of Valuation Allowance, Noncurrent

also: Deferred tax assets operating loss carryforwards noncurrent.

also: Deferred tax liabilities derivatives non current.

also: Defined contribution plan employer additional discretionary contribution amount.

concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Foreign
also: Deferred tax assets: Foreign tax credit carryforward
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign tax credit carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
also: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Total
Deferred tax assets: Compensation and benefits
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
also: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Total
Deferred tax liabilities: Goodwill and acquired indefinite-lived intangibles
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
also: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net, Total
concepts.doc: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
also: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction, Total
concepts.doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction …

concepts.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
also: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

concepts.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
concepts.doc: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

concepts.label: Dividends, Cash
concepts.doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common …

concepts.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
also: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, BEAT, Amount
also: Base erosion and anti-abuse tax , amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to base erosion and anti-abuse tax (BEAT).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, BEAT, Percent
also: Base erosion and anti-abuse tax, rate
concepts.doc: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to base erosion and anti-abuse tax (BEAT).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
also: Valuation allowance from changes in organizational structure, rate

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
also: Impact of federal, foreign, state, and local tax rate changes on deferred taxes, rate
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Amount
also: Other, Effect of cross-border tax laws, amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, GILTI, Amount
also: Global intangible low-taxed income (net of FTC), amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, GILTI, Percent
also: Global intangible low-taxed income (net of FTC), rate
concepts.doc: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
