concepts.label: Employee-related Liabilities
concepts.doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution
also: Distributions of earnings from equity method investees
concepts.doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return on investment, classified as operating activities. Excludes distribution for return of investment, classified as investing activities.

concepts.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Current
also: Equity securities at FVTNI, Fair Value
concepts.doc: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as current.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
also: Total Net Unrealized Gains (Losses) Included in Earnings
concepts.doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Unfunded Commitments
concepts.doc: The amount of unfunded commitments for which the entity is obligated, to those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments).

concepts.label: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
also: Total Net Unrealized Gains (Losses) Included in Earnings
concepts.doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers Into Level 3
concepts.doc: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers out of Level 3
concepts.doc: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases
concepts.doc: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Sales
concepts.doc: Amount of sale of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Transfers Into Level 3
concepts.doc: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers out of Level 3
concepts.doc: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as an asset out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Value
also: Assets measured at fair value, beginning balance
Assets measured at fair value, ending balance
concepts.doc: Fair value of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases
concepts.doc: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability Value
also: Liabilities measured at fair value, beginning balance
Liabilities measured at fair value, ending balance
concepts.doc: Fair value of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

concepts.label: Fair Value of Securities Received as Collateral that Have Been Resold or Repledged

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Remaining Amortization Period

concepts.doc: Remaining amortization period of finite-lived intangible assets, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments

concepts.doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

concepts.label: General and Administrative Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Other Increase (Decrease)
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, classified as other.

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss
also: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Total
concepts.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10

concepts.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
also: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill), Total
concepts.doc: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of an intangible asset (excluding goodwill) to fair value.

concepts.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Finite-Lived
concepts.doc: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of a finite-lived intangible asset to fair value.

concepts.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-Lived (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
also: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received, Total
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received
also: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received, Total
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received

concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
also: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount, Total

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
also: State and local income taxes, net of federal income tax effect, amount

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
also: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount, Total

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
also: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Total
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities
also: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities, Total
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
also: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
also: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
also: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

concepts.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Gross (Excluding Goodwill)

concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated amortization of intangible assets, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
also: Total intangible assets - Net Carrying Amount
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Interest Expense, Nonoperating
concepts.doc: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity

concepts.label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend

concepts.label: Labor and Related Expense

concepts.label: Lease, Cost

concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
also: Total liabilities, temporary equity and permanent equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Fair Value
concepts.doc: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to …

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Ending Balance
Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Beginning Balance
Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by/(used in) financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by/(used in) investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by/(used in) operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
also: Net income attributable to BlackRock, Inc.
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
also: Diluted net income attributable to BlackRock, Inc.
Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted, Total
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Noncash Contribution Expense
concepts.doc: Noncash charitable contributions made by the entity during the period.

concepts.label: Long-Lived Assets
concepts.doc: Long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

concepts.label: Number of Operating Segments
concepts.doc: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the …

concepts.label: Operating Expenses
concepts.doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Payments
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Periodic Reduction
concepts.doc: Amount of periodic reduction over lease term of carrying amount of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Other Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Noncash Income
concepts.doc: Amount of income or gain included in net income that result in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for Restructuring
concepts.doc: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
also: Total consideration, net of cash acquired
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Investments
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
also: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment, Total
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
also: Distributions of capital from equity method investees
concepts.doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
also: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt, Total
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
also: Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
also: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
also: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments, Total
Proceeds from sales and maturities of investments
concepts.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
also: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Ending Balance
Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Beginning Balance
Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Total
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office …

concepts.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Restricted Cash
also: Restricted cash included in other assets
concepts.doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

concepts.label: Restricted Cash, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes cash restricted to withdrawal or usage.

concepts.label: Restricted Stock or Unit Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for award of restricted stock or unit under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Restructuring Charges
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Restructuring Reserve
concepts.doc: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized …

concepts.label: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings not appropriated for specific business purpose.

concepts.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific …

concepts.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of transaction price allocated to performance obligation that has not been recognized as revenue.

concepts.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Expected Timing of Satisfaction, Period
concepts.doc: Period in which remaining performance obligation is expected to be recognized as revenue, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
also: ROU assets in exchange for operating lease liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value of Collateral
also: Separate account collateral liabilities under securities lending agreements
concepts.doc: Fair value of the securities received as collateral against securities borrowed.

concepts.label: Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value Disclosure
also: Fair value of loaned securities held
concepts.doc: Fair value portion of securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, CODM, Individual Title and Position or Group Name [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates title and position of individual or name of group identified as chief operating decision maker (CODM) for segment reporting.

concepts.label: Separate Account Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of asset at fair value held for benefit of separate account policyholder.

concepts.label: Separate Account, Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.

concepts.label: Severance Costs
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or …

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
concepts.doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Weighted-Average Grant Date Fair Value, Forfeited
concepts.doc: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
concepts.doc: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Weighted-Average Grant Date Fair Value, Granted
concepts.doc: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Weighted-Average Grant Date Fair Value, beginning of period
Weighted-Average Grant Date Fair Value, end of period
Weighted-Average Grant Date Fair Value, Granted
concepts.doc: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Period Increase (Decrease)
also: Awards granted that vest in increasing yearly increments
Reduction of shares due to performance measures
concepts.doc: The net total number of shares (or other type of equity) under an equity-based award plan, other than a stock option plan, that were granted, vested and forfeited during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
concepts.doc: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
also: Weighted-Average Grant Date Fair Value, Converted
concepts.doc: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, …

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Outstanding, Number
also: Restricted Stock Units, end of period
Restricted Stock Units, beginning of period
concepts.doc: Number of equity instruments other than options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested instruments.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Shares Authorized
also: Common stock shares authorized for issuance under Award Plan
concepts.doc: Number of shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
also: Outstanding, Shares Under Option, Beginning of Period
Outstanding, Shares Under Option, End of Period
concepts.doc: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered …

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that …

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Shares Exercisable
concepts.doc: The number of shares reserved for issuance pertaining to the outstanding exercisable stock options as of the balance sheet date in the customized range of exercise prices for which the market and performance vesting condition has been satisfied.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Exercisable at December 31, 2022, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Life
Options Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Life (years)
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Outstanding, Shares Under Option, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Life
Options Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Life (years)
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Sponsor Fees
concepts.doc: Fees paid to advisors who provide certain management support and administrative oversight services including the organization and sale of stock, investment funds, limited partnerships and mutual funds.

concepts.label: Stock Issued
also: Issuance of common shares related to employee stock transactions
concepts.doc: The fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
also: Issuance of common shares in connection with the GIP Transaction
Issuance of common share in connection with acquisition
concepts.doc: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
also: Issuance of common shares related to employee stock transactions
concepts.doc: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

concepts.label: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent
also: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent, Ending Balance
Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent, Beginning Balance
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Additional Paid-in Capital, value of stock
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Leverage Capital, Actual
also: Tier 1 capital (to average assets), Actual, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of Tier 1 leverage capital as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Leverage Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
also: Tier 1 capital (to average assets), For Capital Adequacy Purposes, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Leverage Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
also: Tier 1 capital (to average assets), For Capital Adequacy Purposes, Ratio
concepts.doc: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Leverage Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
concepts.doc: Amount of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Leverage Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
concepts.doc: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Leverage Capital Ratio, Actual
also: Tier 1 capital (to average assets), Actual, Ratio
concepts.doc: Ratio of Tier 1 capital to average assets as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital, Actual
also: Tier 1 capital (to risk weighted assets), Actual, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of Tier 1 risk-based capital as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
also: Tier 1 capital (to risk weighted assets), For Capital Adequacy Purposes, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
also: Tier 1 capital (to risk weighted assets), For Capital Adequacy Purposes, Ratio
concepts.doc: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
concepts.doc: Amount of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
concepts.doc: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

concepts.label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Actual
also: Tier 1 capital (to risk weighted assets), Actual, Ratio
concepts.doc: Ratio of Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Trading
concepts.doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Amortized Cost
concepts.doc: Amortized cost of investments in debt securities classified as trading.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Used in Net Investment Hedge, after Tax
also: Gain (loss) from net investment hedging, net of tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of net investment hedge.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
concepts.doc: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Retired, Cost Method, Amount
also: Cancellation of treasury stock, common in connection with the GIP Transaction
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the cost method.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Retired, Par Value Method, Amount
also: Cancellation of treasury stock, common in connection with the GIP Transaction
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the par value method.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Value
concepts.doc: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
concepts.doc: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
also: Reductions for tax positions of prior years
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
also: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued, Total
concepts.doc: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Acquisition
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
also: Additions based on tax positions related to current year
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
also: Additions for tax positions of prior years
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
also: Unrecognized tax benefits that would affect effective tax rate if recognized
concepts.doc: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

concepts.label: Variable Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
concepts.doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
also: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic, Total
concepts.doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been …

concepts.label: Auditor Firm ID
concepts.doc: PCAOB issued Audit Firm Identifier

concepts.label: Auditor Location
Auditor Name
City Area Code
concepts.doc: Area code of city

concepts.label: Current Fiscal Year End Date
concepts.doc: End date of current fiscal year in the format --MM-DD.

concepts.label: Document Fiscal Period Focus
concepts.doc: Fiscal period values are FY, Q1, Q2, and Q3. 1st, 2nd and 3rd quarter 10-Q or 10-QT statements have value Q1, Q2, and Q3 respectively, with 10-K, 10-KT or other fiscal year statements having FY.

concepts.label: Document Type
concepts.doc: The type of document being provided (such as 10-K, 10-Q, 485BPOS, etc). The document type is limited to the same value as the supporting SEC submission type, or the word 'Other'.

concepts.label: Entity Address, Address Line One
concepts.doc: Address Line 1 such as Attn, Building Name, Street Name

concepts.label: Entity Address, City or Town
concepts.doc: Name of the City or Town

concepts.label: Entity Address, Postal Zip Code
concepts.doc: Code for the postal or zip code

concepts.label: Entity Address, State or Province
concepts.doc: Name of the state or province.

concepts.label: Entity Central Index Key
concepts.doc: A unique 10-digit SEC-issued value to identify entities that have filed disclosures with the SEC. It is commonly abbreviated as CIK.

concepts.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding

concepts.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

concepts.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
concepts.doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Advertising Expense
concepts.doc: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts

Amortization of debt discount and issuance costs
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets.

concepts.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount

concepts.label: Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

concepts.label: Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of unrealized loss in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Business Combination, Acquisition-Related Cost, Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees; and general administrative cost, including cost of maintaining internal acquisition department.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Change in Contingent Consideration, Liability, Increase (Decrease)
also: Change in fair value of contingent consideration liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination, including, but not limited to, difference arising upon settlement.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Noncurrent

concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Recognized Liability Assumed, Deferred Tax Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

concepts.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid

concepts.doc: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

concepts.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Amortization

concepts.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Net
concepts.doc: The carrying amount of capitalized computer software costs net of accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization Period
also: Deferred contract acquisition cost amortization period
concepts.doc: Amortization period of cost capitalized in obtaining or fulfilling contract with customer, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Impairment Loss

concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Current
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as current.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect and Discontinued Operation

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
concepts.doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

concepts.label: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital
concepts.doc: Amount of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock issued.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
also: Deferred revenue, net of current portion
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

concepts.label: Cost of Goods and Service, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net

concepts.doc: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Excluding Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Allocated Share-Based Compensation Expense

concepts.doc: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Interest Carryforward

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Asset, In-Process Research and Development
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Foreign
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-Based Compensation Cost
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Prepaid Expenses
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from prepaid expenses.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Employees' Gross Pay
concepts.doc: Percentage of employees' gross pay for which the employer contributes a matching contribution to a defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Match

concepts.doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction

concepts.doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

concepts.doc: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
also: State and local income tax, net of federal tax effect
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for asset, excluding financial asset and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …
