concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: General and Administrative Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
also: Impairment of goodwill and intangible assets
concepts.doc: Total loss recognized during the period from the impairment of goodwill plus the loss recognized in the period resulting from the impairment of the carrying amount of intangible assets, other than goodwill.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
also: Impairment of goodwill and intangible assets
concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment loss for goodwill.

concepts.label: Impairment, Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived (Excluding Goodwill), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment of indefinite-lived intangible asset excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-Lived (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
also: U.S. federal income taxes paid, net
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
concepts.doc: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
also: State and local income tax, net of federal tax effect
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid
also: Cash paid for income taxes, net
concepts.doc: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating
concepts.doc: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation …

concepts.label: Interest Payable, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year …

concepts.label: Interest Receivable
concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
also: Less: Current portion of long-term debt
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
also: Long-term debt, net of current portion
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash (used in) provided by financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired
also: Purchase of intangible assets included in accounts payable and accrued liabilities
concepts.doc: The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that …

concepts.label: Number of Operating Segments
concepts.doc: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the …

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Operating Expenses
concepts.doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
also: Operating lease liabilities, net of current portion
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
also: Weighted-average operating lease discount rate (in percentage)
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
also: Change in foreign currency translation adjustment
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
also: Change in net unrealized gains (losses) on available for sale investments
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security …

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Other Item
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
concepts.doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

concepts.label: Payments of Financing Costs
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
also: Acquisition of businesses, net of cash acquired
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Investments
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
also: Preferred stock, par value (in USD per share)
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
also: Proceeds from issuance of long-term debt, net of issuance costs
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
also: Proceeds from employee stock purchase plan
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
also: Proceeds from the sale and maturity of short-term investments
concepts.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
also: Proceeds from the sale of property and equipment
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
also: Proceeds from exercise of stock options
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office …

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
also: Current period provision for expected credit losses
concepts.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
concepts.doc: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

concepts.label: Repayments of Other Debt
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Research and Development Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or …

concepts.label: Restructuring Reserve
concepts.doc: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized …

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

concepts.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific …

concepts.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of transaction price allocated to performance obligation that has not been recognized as revenue.

concepts.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Expected Timing of Satisfaction, Period
concepts.doc: Period in which remaining performance obligation is expected to be recognized as revenue, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Percentage
concepts.doc: Percentage of remaining performance obligation to total remaining performance obligation not recognized as revenue.

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
also: Operating lease right-of-use assets obtained in exchange for operating lease obligations
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Selling and Marketing Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total amount of expenses directly related to the marketing or selling of products or services.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Requisite Service Period
concepts.doc: Estimated period over which an employee is required to provide service in exchange for the equity-based payment award, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
concepts.doc: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Vested and exercisable (in USD per share)
concepts.doc: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
concepts.doc: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Options cancelled/expired , weighted-average exercise price, (in USD per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average price of options that were either forfeited or expired.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
also: Option shares outstanding, aggregate intrinsic value
concepts.doc: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
also: Outstanding at beginning or period (in shares)
Outstanding at end of period (in shares)
concepts.doc: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
also: Option shares vested and expected to vest, aggregate intrinsic value
concepts.doc: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that …

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Number
also: Vested and expected to vest (in shares)
concepts.doc: Number of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding that can be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected …

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Vested and expected to vest (in USD per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that …

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
also: Option shares vested and exercisable, aggregate intrinsic value
concepts.doc: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Vested and exercisable, weighted average remaining contractual life
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Option shares outstanding, weighted average remaining contractual life
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Vested and expected to vest, weighted average remaining contractual life
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for …

concepts.label: Shares, Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares of stock issued as of the balance sheet date, including shares that had been issued and were previously outstanding but which are now held in the treasury.

concepts.label: Shares, Outstanding
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

concepts.label: Short-Term Investments
concepts.doc: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

concepts.label: Short-Term Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
also: Issuance of common stock as acquisition consideration
Common stock issued in connection with business acquisitions
concepts.doc: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
also: Issuance of common stock under ESPP
concepts.doc: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
also: Vesting of restricted stock units and restricted shares
concepts.doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
concepts.doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

concepts.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
concepts.doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own …

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent

concepts.doc: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
also: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
also: State income taxes, net of federal benefit
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
also: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not …

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
also: Total income tax payments, net of refunds
Cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds
concepts.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
also: Indefinite lived intangible assets - Trade names, trademarks, and distribution rights
concepts.doc: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Interest Income (Expense), Operating
concepts.doc: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
also: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation …

concepts.label: Inventory, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Renewal Term
concepts.doc: Term of lessee's operating lease renewal, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation
also: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
also: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
concepts.doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
Net cash used in financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Net cash used in investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
Net cash provided by operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
also: Net income attributable to Watsco, Inc.
Net income attributable to Watsco, Inc. shareholders
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Less: net income attributable to non-controlling interest
concepts.doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
also: Earnings allocated to Watsco, Inc. shareholders - Basic
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
also: Earnings allocated to Watsco, Inc. shareholders - Diluted
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Number of Operating Segments
concepts.doc: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the …

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
also: Current portion of operating lease liabilities
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes current operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
also: Operating lease liabilities, net of current portion
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of current assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
also: Other comprehensive income (loss), net of tax Foreign currency translation adjustment
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Basic
also: Less: distributed and undistributed earnings allocated to restricted common stock
concepts.doc: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

concepts.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Diluted
also: Less: distributed and undistributed earnings allocated to restricted common stock
concepts.doc: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

concepts.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
also: Payment of fees related to revolving credit agreement
concepts.doc: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
also: Payments Related to Tax Withholding for Share-based Compensation
Repurchases of common stock to satisfy employee withholding tax obligations
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
also: Business acquisitions, net of cash acquired
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises …

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Short-Term Investments
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were …

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
also: Preferred stock, $0.50 par value, 10,000,000 shares authorized; no shares issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

concepts.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
also: Proceeds from issuances of Common stock under employee related plans
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
also: Proceeds from sale of property and equipment
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Short-Term Investments
also: Proceeds from maturities of short-term cash investments
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
also: Net proceeds from the sale of Common stock
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office …

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
concepts.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Purchase Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
concepts.doc: Minimum amount to be expended to satisfy the terms of arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, excluding long-term purchase commitments or unconditional purchase obligations.

concepts.label: Repayments of Long-Term Lines of Credit
also: Net repayments under prior revolving credit agreement
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at …

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

concepts.label: Revenues
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of …

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
also: Operating lease ROU assets obtained in exchange for operating lease obligations
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, CODM, Individual Title and Position or Group Name [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates title and position of individual or name of group identified as chief operating decision maker (CODM) for segment reporting.

concepts.label: Self Insurance Reserve
concepts.doc: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions) of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being …

concepts.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale …

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate
concepts.doc: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the option's term.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
concepts.doc: The estimated measure of the percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share …

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate
concepts.doc: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
concepts.doc: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
concepts.doc: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
concepts.doc: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
concepts.doc: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
concepts.doc: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
concepts.doc: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
concepts.doc: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Weighted-Average Exercise Price, Outstanding ending balance
Weighted-Average Exercise Price, Outstanding beginning balance
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
concepts.doc: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term
concepts.doc: Expected term of award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Weighted-Average Remaining Contractual Term (in years), Exercisable
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Weighted-Average Remaining Contractual Term (in years), Outstanding
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Short-Term Investments
concepts.doc: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

concepts.label: Short-Term Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
concepts.doc: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
concepts.doc: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
concepts.doc: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
concepts.doc: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
also: Issuance of Class B common stock
concepts.doc: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
also: Net proceeds from the sale of Common stock
concepts.doc: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized, Number of Shares
also: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
Remaining number of shares authorized to be repurchased
concepts.doc: Number of shares remaining authorized to be purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

concepts.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
concepts.doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid …

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

concepts.label: Sublease Income
concepts.doc: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

concepts.label: Treasury Stock, Value
also: Aggregate cost of common stock repurchased under the plan
concepts.doc: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

concepts.label: Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
concepts.doc: Amount of undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries intended to be permanently reinvested outside the country of domicile.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
also: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued, Total
Estimated accrued interest and penalties resulting from unrecognized tax benefits
concepts.doc: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
also: Additions based on tax positions related to the current year
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
also: Reductions due to lapse of applicable statute of limitations
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
also: Unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate
concepts.doc: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

concepts.label: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount
also: Maximum exposure to loss related to involvement with variable interest entity
concepts.doc: The reporting entity's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

concepts.label: Variable Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted, Adjustment
also: Weighted Average Number Diluted Shares Outstanding Adjustment
concepts.doc: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.
