concepts.doc: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
concepts.doc: The number of limited partner units outstanding.

concepts.label: Long-Term Line of Credit
also: Outstanding under line of credit facility
concepts.doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Marketable Securities
concepts.doc: Amount of investment in marketable security.

concepts.label: Marketable Security, Realized Gain (Loss)
also: Gain on sale of marketable securities
Gain on sale of investments in marketable securities
concepts.doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
concepts.doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
also: Acquisition of subsidiary interest from noncontrolling interest
Redemption and conversion of common units
concepts.doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares …

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate
concepts.doc: Amount of investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Amortization of Premium
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from amortization of premium.

concepts.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net
concepts.doc: The balance represents the amount of loans that are secured by real estate mortgages, offset by the reserve to cover probable credit losses on the loan portfolio.

concepts.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Significant, Plan Contribution
concepts.doc: Amount of contribution received by multiemployer pension plan from all employers participating in multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually significant.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash (used in) provided by investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
also: Net (loss) income attributable to SL Green
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Net loss attributable to noncontrolling interests
concepts.doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
also: Net (loss) income attributable to SL Green common stockholders
(Loss) income attributable to SL Green common stockholders
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
also: Net (loss) income attributable to SL Green common stockholders, diluted
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Redeemable
also: Noncontrolling interests in the Operating Partnership
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Redeemable
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

concepts.label: Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Operating Costs and Expenses
concepts.doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
also: Real Estate segment net operating income
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income
concepts.doc: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income, Lease Payments
concepts.doc: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Excludes variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Variable Lease Income
concepts.doc: Amount of operating lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Other Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of assets classified as other.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
also: Increase (decrease) in unrealized value of marketable securities
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
also: Amount of Gain (Loss) Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
also: Other comprehensive loss (income) attributable to noncontrolling interests
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
concepts.doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

concepts.label: Other Income
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Receivables
concepts.doc: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

concepts.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

concepts.label: Payments of Dividends
also: Dividends paid on common and preferred stock
Distributions paid on common and preferred units
concepts.doc: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Payments of Financing Costs
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
also: Tax withholdings related to restricted share awards
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Payments To Acquire Commercial Real Estate
concepts.doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of property as primarily intended to generate income for its owner.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises …

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Securities, FV-NI
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

concepts.label: us-gaap_PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable
also: Investments in real estate loans held by consolidated securitization vehicles
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

concepts.label: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
also: Acquisition of subsidiary interest from noncontrolling interest
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference Per Share
also: Preferred stock, liquidation preference (in dollars per share)
Perpetual Preferred stock, liquidation preference (in dollars per share)
concepts.doc: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the …

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
also: Preferred stock, par (in dollars per share)
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
also: Distributions in excess of cumulative earnings from unconsolidated joint ventures
concepts.doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
also: Dividend reinvestments/stock purchases under the DRSPP
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
also: Proceeds from mortgages and other loans payable
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
also: Proceeds from revolving credit facility, term loans and senior unsecured notes
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
also: Contributions from noncontrolling interests to debt fund investments
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
also: Net proceeds from disposition of real estate/joint venture interest
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
also: Proceeds from sale or redemption of marketable securities
concepts.doc: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
also: Proceeds from sale of marketable securities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Securities, FV-NI
also: Proceeds from sale of equity marketable securities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
also: Proceeds from stock options exercised and DRSPP issuance
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Provision for losses
also: Current period provision for loan loss
Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
concepts.doc: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation pertaining to real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Building and Improvements, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of buildings and improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Land, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of land for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Initial Cost of Building and Improvements
concepts.doc: Initial cost of buildings and improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Initial Cost of Land
concepts.doc: Initial cost of land for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

concepts.label: us-gaap_RealEstateGrossAtCarryingValue
also: Carrying value of investment in leasehold interest
concepts.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of real estate investment by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes real estate not held as investment or interest.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Improvements
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in real estate investments related to improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

concepts.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Accumulated Depreciation
concepts.doc: The cumulative amount of depreciation for real estate property held for investment purposes.

concepts.label: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
also: Total commercial real estate properties, at cost
concepts.doc: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

concepts.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Net
also: Total commercial real estate properties, net
concepts.doc: Amount of real estate investment property, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other …

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Other Acquisition
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in real estate investments from acquisitions other than through foreclosure for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

concepts.label: Real Estate Tax Expense
concepts.doc: A tax based on the assessed value of real estate by the local government. The tax is usually based on the value of property (including the land).

concepts.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Carrying Amount
concepts.doc: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the …

concepts.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Carrying Amount
concepts.doc: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the …

concepts.label: Repayments of Secured Debt
also: Repayments of mortgages and other loans payable
concepts.doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

concepts.label: Repayments of Unsecured Debt
also: Repayments of revolving credit facility, term loans and senior unsecured notes
concepts.doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.

concepts.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalent
concepts.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is …

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

concepts.label: Revenues
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of …

concepts.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
also: Recognition of lease liabilities arising from obtaining right-of-use assets
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Depreciation Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of depreciation expense of real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Cost Capitalized Subsequent to Acquisition, Building and Improvements
concepts.doc: Amount of building and improvement costs capitalized since acquisition for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

concepts.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Cost Capitalized Subsequent to Acquisition, Land
concepts.doc: Amount of land costs capitalized since acquisition for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

concepts.label: Sale of Stock, Number of Shares Issued in Transaction
concepts.doc: The number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee per stock transaction.

concepts.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Payment to be Received
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases.

concepts.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Payment to be Received, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position …

concepts.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Payment to be Received, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position …

concepts.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Payment to be Received, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position …

concepts.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Payment to be Received, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position …

concepts.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Payment to be Received, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position …

concepts.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Payment to be Received, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position …

concepts.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of undiscounted lease receivable in excess of discounted receivable for sales-type and direct financing leases.

concepts.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income
concepts.doc: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type lease.

concepts.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.

concepts.label: Secured Debt
also: Mortgages and other loans payable, net
Total mortgages and other loans payable, net
concepts.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date, including the current and noncurrent portions, of collateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer). Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and …

concepts.label: Security Deposit Liability
concepts.doc: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include …

concepts.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale …

concepts.label: Senior Notes
concepts.doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or …

concepts.label: Servicing Asset
concepts.doc: Aggregate amount of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing assets that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

concepts.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost
concepts.doc: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

concepts.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Amount
