Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period
concepts.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account …

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
also: Net increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents
concepts.doc: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, …

concepts.label: Cash Surrender Value of Life Insurance
concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.

concepts.label: Commitments and Contingencies
concepts.doc: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is …

concepts.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
also: Dividends per common share (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
also: Common shares, par value (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
concepts.doc: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and …

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
concepts.doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value …

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
also: Revenue recognized in contract liabilities balance
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

concepts.label: Contractual Obligation
also: Bank guarantees and letter of credits, outstanding
concepts.doc: Amount of contractual obligation, including, but not limited to, long-term debt, lease obligation, purchase obligation, and other commitments.

concepts.label: Cost of Revenue
concepts.doc: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Credit Risk Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
concepts.doc: Fair value of credit risk derivative asset after deduction of credit risk derivative liability.

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable beyond one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until …

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current and Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

concepts.label: Deferred Compensation Plan Assets
concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of assets held under deferred compensation agreements.

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Derivative Instruments
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from derivative instruments.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
also: Net of deferred tax assets and liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
also: Total deferred tax assets, net of valuation allowance
concepts.doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Domestic
also: Deferred tax assets related to net operating loss carryforwards, excluding state
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible domestic operating loss carryforwards. Excludes state and local operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Not Subject to Expiration
also: Net operating loss of subsidiary, carried forward
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are not subject to expiration dates.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, State and Local
also: Additional deferred tax assets for U.S. state and local tax loss carry-forwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible state and local operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Postretirement Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from postretirement benefits.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-Based Compensation Cost
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserve and Accrual, Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Derivatives
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from derivatives.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
also: Investments in foreign subsidiaries not indefinitely reinvested
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Gain (Loss), before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost …

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
concepts.doc: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
also: Projected benefit obligation at the beginning of the year
Projected benefit obligation at the end of the year
concepts.doc: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Benefits Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of payment to participant of defined benefit plan which decreases benefit obligation. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription …

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Remeasurement due to Settlement
concepts.doc: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from remeasurement due to settlement. Excludes decrease to benefit obligation for settlement payment.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
concepts.doc: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Curtailment
concepts.doc: Amount of (increase) decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Next Fiscal Year
concepts.doc: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
also: Fair value of plan assets at the beginning of the year
Fair value of plan assets at the end of the year
concepts.doc: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
concepts.doc: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
concepts.doc: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) Excluding Service Cost, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes components of net periodic benefit cost (credit), excluding service cost component, for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
also: Fair value of plan assets at the end of the year
concepts.doc: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
concepts.doc: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
also: Fair value of plan assets at the end of the year
concepts.doc: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
also: Reclassification adjustment from AOCI, after tax
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change in terms of existing plan or initiation of new plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Benefits Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription …

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) plan assets of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Service Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Deposits Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment within one year or during the operating cycle, if shorter.

concepts.label: Deposits Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset
concepts.doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract …

concepts.label: Derivative Asset, Current
concepts.doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract …

concepts.label: Derivative Asset, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract …

concepts.label: Derivative Liability
concepts.doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or …

concepts.label: Derivative Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or …

concepts.label: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or …

concepts.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
concepts.doc: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
also: Loss on sale of business classified as held for sale
Loss on the sale of business classified as held for sale
concepts.doc: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

concepts.label: Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
also: Earnings per common share, basic (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
also: Earnings per common share, diluted (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common …

concepts.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Including Discontinued Operation
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, FDII, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax benefit from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to foreign-derived intangible income (FDII).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
also: Excess tax benefit on share-based compensation
concepts.doc: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
also: Worldwide changes in unrecognized tax benefits
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but …

concepts.label: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to …

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Awards, Compensation Not yet Recognized, Stock Options
also: Unrecognized stock-based compensation cost for options
Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of cost to be recognized for option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
concepts.doc: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Exercise of Option, Tax Benefit
also: Tax benefits from the exercise of stock option
concepts.doc: Amount of tax benefit from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
also: Operating cash outflows for finance leases
concepts.doc: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
also: Finance lease, liability, current, statement of financial position [Extensible List]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes current finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes noncurrent finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Next Rolling 12 Months
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease due in next rolling 12 months following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement …

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement …

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement …

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement …

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
also: Financing cash outflows for finance leases
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
also: Right of use of assets finance lease
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes finance lease right-of-use asset.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for finance lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for asset, excluding financial asset and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

concepts.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
also: Unrealized (gain)/loss on revaluation of foreign currency assets/liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness, Net
also: Gain (loss) recognized in income, ineffective portion
concepts.doc: The net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
also: Goodwill relating to acquisitions consummated during the period
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Measurement Period Adjustment
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from measurement period adjustment of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Gross Profit
concepts.doc: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

concepts.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
also: Write-down of property, plant and equipment (refer to Note 20)
Write-down of property, plant and equipment
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
also: Net excess tax benefits on share-based compensation
concepts.doc: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received
also: Income taxes, net of amounts refunded
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
also: Impact of change in tax rates
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
also: Effect of rates different than statutory
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
concepts.doc: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
also: Worldwide changes in unrecognized tax benefits
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income exempt from income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid
also: Cash paid during the period for income taxes, net of refund
concepts.doc: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

concepts.label: Interest and Debt Expense
concepts.doc: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

concepts.label: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating
concepts.doc: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
also: Cash paid during the period for interest (including interest rate swaps)
concepts.doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation …

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Rolling Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Next Rolling 12 Months
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.doc: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash used for financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash used for investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Nontrade Receivables, Current
concepts.doc: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Number of Countries in which Entity Operates
concepts.doc: The number of countries in which the entity operates as of balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Number of Reportable Segments
concepts.doc: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion …

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Impairment Loss
also: Write-down of operating right-of-use assets (refer to Note 20)
concepts.doc: Amount of loss from impairment of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Payments
also: Operating cash outflows for operating leases
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.doc: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining lease term for operating lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount of operating loss carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

concepts.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of current assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
also: Other assets, net of allowance for credit losses
concepts.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a …

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
also: Gain (loss) on cash flow hedging derivatives, net of taxes (Note 6)
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
also: Amount of Gain (Loss) recognized in OCI on Derivatives (Effective Portion)
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
also: Amount of Gain (Loss) reclassified from OCI into Statement of Income (Effective Portion)
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
also: Accrued expenses and other current liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
concepts.doc: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

concepts.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer), from the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
also: Payment of debt issuance and refinancing costs
concepts.doc: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
also: Payment for net settlement of stock-based awards
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
also: Payment for business acquisitions, net of cash acquired
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
also: Purchase of property, plant and equipment
concepts.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Short-Term Investments
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were …

concepts.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

concepts.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
also: Non-current liabilities (recorded under other liabilities- retirement benefits)
concepts.doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
also: Preferred shares, par value (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
also: Preferred shares, $0.01 par value, 250,000,000 authorized, none issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
also: Prepaid expenses and other current assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if …

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance for expenses which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Prepaid Taxes
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
concepts.doc: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
also: Proceeds from issuance of common shares under stock-based compensation plans
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Short-Term Investments
also: Proceeds from maturity of short term investments
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified …

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
also: Proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
also: Cash received from the exercise of stock option
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office …

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
also: Allowance for credit losses (refer to Note 4)
concepts.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

concepts.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Repayments of Short-Term Debt
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Restricted Stock, Value, Shares Issued Net of Tax Withholdings
also: Net settlement on vesting of restricted share units (Note 17)
concepts.doc: Value, after value of shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

concepts.label: Restructuring Charges
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

concepts.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific …

concepts.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Amount
also: Transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations
concepts.doc: Amount of transaction price allocated to performance obligation that has not been recognized as revenue.

concepts.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Expected Timing of Satisfaction, Period
concepts.doc: Period in which remaining performance obligation is expected to be recognized as revenue, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
concepts.doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale …

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
also: Vested and exercisable, shares arising out of options (in shares)
concepts.doc: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Vested and exercisable, weighted average exercise price (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
also: Expired, shares arising out of options (in shares)
concepts.doc: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
also: Forfeited, shares arising out of options (in shares)
concepts.doc: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
also: Granted, shares arising out of options (in shares)
concepts.doc: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
concepts.doc: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
concepts.doc: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
also: Outstanding, shares arising out of options, beginning balance (in shares)
Outstanding, shares arising out of options, ending balance (in shares)
concepts.doc: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Outstanding weighted average exercise price, beginning balance (in usd per share)
Outstanding weighted average exercise price, ending balance (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
also: Vested and expected to vest thereafter, aggregate intrinsic value
