concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Number
also: Vested and expected to vest thereafter, shares arising out of options (in shares)
concepts.doc: Number of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding that can be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected …

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Vested and expected to vest thereafter, weighted average exercise price (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that …

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Exercised, weighted average exercise price (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Expired, weighted average exercise price (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

concepts.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Forfeited, weighted average exercise price (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
also: Granted, weighted average exercise price (in usd per share)
concepts.doc: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
also: Vested and exercisable, aggregate intrinsic value
concepts.doc: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Vested and exercisable, weighted average remaining contractual life (years)
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
also: Outstanding weighted average remaining contractual life, beginning balance (years)
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
concepts.doc: Weighted average remaining contractual term for fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for …

concepts.label: Short-Term Debt
concepts.doc: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Short-Term Investments
concepts.doc: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

concepts.label: Short-Term Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
also: Issuance of common shares on exercise of options (in shares)
Exercised, shares arising out of options (in shares)
concepts.doc: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
also: Issuance of common shares under the employee stock purchase plan (Note 17)
concepts.doc: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
also: Issuance of common shares on exercise of options (Note 17)
concepts.doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

concepts.label: Share Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized, Amount
also: Stock repurchase program remained available for share
concepts.doc: Amount remaining authorized for purchase of share under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

concepts.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
concepts.doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Shares Acquired, Average Cost Per Share
also: Common stock shares repurchased price per share (in US dollars per share)
concepts.doc: Total cost of shares repurchased divided by the total number of shares repurchased.

concepts.doc: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
also: Decrease related to prior year tax positions for other reasons
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
also: Decrease related to settlements with taxing authorities
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Accrued
concepts.doc: Amount of statutory penalties accrued for a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed by the entity, in its tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
also: Increase related to current year tax positions
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
also: Increase related to prior year tax positions, including recorded in acquisition accounting
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Accrued
concepts.doc: Amount of interest expense accrued for an underpayment of income taxes.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
concepts.doc: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

concepts.label: Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Increase (Decrease), Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for a specified deferred tax asset.

concepts.label: Variable Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted, Adjustment
also: Dilutive effect of stock-based awards (in shares)
concepts.doc: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
concepts.doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic

concepts.doc: The type of document being provided (such as 10-K, 10-Q, 485BPOS, etc). The document type is limited to the same value as the supporting SEC submission type, or the word 'Other'.

concepts.doc: Address Line 2 such as Street or Suite number

concepts.doc: Commission file number. The field allows up to 17 characters. The prefix may contain 1-3 digits, the sequence number may contain 1-8 digits, the optional suffix may contain 1-4 characters, and the fields are separated with a hyphen.

concepts.doc: Indicate whether the registrant is one of the following: Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Non-accelerated Filer. Definitions of these categories are stated in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most …

concepts.doc: Two-character EDGAR code representing the state or country of incorporation.

concepts.doc: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant has submitted electronically every Interactive Data File required to be submitted pursuant to Rule 405 of Regulation S-T during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that the registrant was …

concepts.label: Entity Registrant Name
concepts.doc: The exact name of the entity filing the report as specified in its charter, which is required by forms filed with the SEC.

concepts.label: Entity Tax Identification Number
concepts.doc: The Tax Identification Number (TIN), also known as an Employer Identification Number (EIN), is a unique 9-digit value assigned by the IRS.

concepts.label: Entity Voluntary Filers
concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is not required to file reports pursuant to Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Act.

concepts.label: Entity Well-known Seasoned Issuer
concepts.doc: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is a well-known seasoned issuer, as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act. Is used on Form Type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 20-F/A, 6-K/A, N-CSR, N-Q, N-1A.

concepts.label: Local Phone Number
concepts.doc: Local phone number for entity.

concepts.label: Title of 12(b) Security
concepts.doc: Title of a 12(b) registered security.

concepts.label: Security Exchange Name
concepts.doc: Name of the Exchange on which a security is registered.

concepts.label: Trading Symbol
concepts.doc: Trading symbol of an instrument as listed on an exchange.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Unrealized Currency Loss And Other Comprehensive Loss
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowance of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses on foreign currency transactions and currency translations

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Accrued Sales Discounts
concepts.doc: Deferred Tax Assets, Accrued Sales Discounts

also: Trade receivables and contract assets, allowance

concepts.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all currently due domestic and foreign income tax obligations.

concepts.label: Accrued Liabilities and Other Liabilities
also: Accrued expenses and other current liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid nor invoiced, and liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

concepts.label: Additional Paid in Capital
concepts.doc: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
concepts.doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense
concepts.doc: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

concepts.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets.

concepts.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
also: Anti-dilutive stock excluded from the calculation (in shares)

concepts.label: Asset Impairment Charges
concepts.doc: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

concepts.label: Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

concepts.label: Assets, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

concepts.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure

concepts.label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Pro Forma Income (Loss), after Tax

concepts.label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Pro Forma Revenue
concepts.doc: Amount of pro forma revenue of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
concepts.doc: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

concepts.doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value …

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Performance Obligation Satisfied in Previous Period
also: Revenues from performance obligations satisfied in previous period
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue recognized from performance obligation satisfied or partially satisfied in previous reporting periods. Includes, but is not limited to, change in transaction price.

concepts.label: Cost of Revenue
also: Cost of revenues (exclusive of depreciation and amortization)
concepts.doc: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Revenue
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Asset, In-Process Research and Development
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.doc: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-Based Compensation Cost
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Contingencies
concepts.doc: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from contingent liabilities.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Leasing Arrangements
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from leasing arrangements.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
concepts.doc: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
concepts.doc: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
concepts.doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction …

concepts.label: Derivative Liability, Current
concepts.doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or …

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common …

concepts.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
also: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
also: U.S. federal statutory income tax rate
concepts.doc: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Amount
also: Effect of other cross-border tax laws
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Percent
also: Effect of other cross-border tax laws
concepts.doc: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
also: Excess tax benefits relating to stock-based compensation
concepts.doc: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
also: Domestic state/local income taxes, net of federal benefit
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
concepts.doc: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not …

concepts.label: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to …

concepts.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Awards, Compensation Not yet Recognized, Stock Options
also: Unrecognized compensation cost net of estimated forfeitures
Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of cost to be recognized for option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
also: Excess tax benefits (shortfall) upon vesting or exercise of stock awards
concepts.doc: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Amount
also: Carrying amount of equity securities that do not have readily determinable fair values
concepts.doc: Amount of investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for asset, excluding financial asset and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current …

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
concepts.doc: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
concepts.doc: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
concepts.doc: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member …

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
also: Effect of net foreign currency exchange rate changes
concepts.doc: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Government Assistance, Expense, Decrease (Increase)
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance.

concepts.label: Government Assistance, Expense, Decrease (Increase), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
also: Income before provision for income taxes
concepts.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
concepts.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
also: Impact of election to change entity classification
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
also: U.S. federal statutory income tax rate
concepts.doc: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
also: Domestic state/local income taxes, net of federal benefit
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax …

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not …

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-Based Payment Arrangements
also: Net effect of dilutive equity awards and stock issuable under the ESPP (in shares)
concepts.doc: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

concepts.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
also: Indefinite-lived intangible assets other than goodwill
concepts.doc: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation …

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling …

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
also: Total liabilities measured at fair value on a recurring basis
concepts.doc: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
also: Purchase of subsidiary shares from noncontrolling interest
concepts.doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash used in financing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash used in investing activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and …

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
also: Net cash provided by operating activities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
also: Numerator for basic earnings per share
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
also: Numerator for diluted earnings per share
concepts.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination
also: Noncontrolling interests acquired in business combination
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

concepts.label: Long-Lived Assets
concepts.doc: Long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
concepts.doc: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current

also: Gain on sales of assets after tax
Net income (loss) from continuing operations including noncontrolling interests

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
also: Net Income (Loss) From Discontinued Operations, after tax
Net income (loss) attributable to Dominion Energy

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
concepts.doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received

concepts.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities

concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the assets (liabilities) created through trading commodity-based derivative instruments.

concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
concepts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
also: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits

concepts.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

concepts.label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross

concepts.label: Investment Income, Interest
concepts.doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

concepts.label: Investment, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates type of investment. concepts.doc: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.doc: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to interest.

concepts.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term unsecured obligations issued by corporations and other borrowers to investors (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

concepts.doc: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).

concepts.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.doc: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
concepts.doc: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes current operating lease liability.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent

concepts.doc: Amount of operating loss carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

concepts.doc: The portion of the valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from net operating loss carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.
