concepts.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
also: Net pension and other postretirement benefit costs (credits), net of tax
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
also: Net pension and other postretirement benefit costs (credits), tax
concepts.doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
also: Changes in unrealized net gains (losses) on investment securities, net of tax
Changes in unrealized net gains (losses) on investment securities
concepts.doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security …

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
also: Changes in unrealized net gains (losses) on investment securities, tax
concepts.doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) …

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
also: Other deferred credits and other liabilities
concepts.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Long-Term Debt, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Long-Term Investments
concepts.doc: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
concepts.doc: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

concepts.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current
also: Other receivables (less allowance for doubtful accounts)
concepts.doc: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
also: Payment for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
also: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets, Total
concepts.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

concepts.label: Payments Of Distributions To Affiliates
concepts.doc: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
concepts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Projects
concepts.doc: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
concepts.doc: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value …

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
concepts.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds From Contributions From Affiliates
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
concepts.doc: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
also: Issuance and remarketing of long-term debt
Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt, Total
concepts.doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
also: Proceeds from Lines of Credit, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
also: Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity
concepts.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
concepts.doc: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
also: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Beginning Balance
concepts.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
also: Total property, plant and equipment, net
concepts.doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office …

concepts.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
concepts.doc: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

concepts.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress
concepts.doc: Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.

concepts.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Distribution
concepts.doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility distribution.

concepts.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Fuel
concepts.doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to fuels owned by the public utility.

concepts.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Generation or Processing
concepts.doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to generation or processing owned by public utility.

concepts.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.doc: Period end book value of other property, plant and equipment (PPE) owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

concepts.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission
also: Proposed capital cost of energy storage system
concepts.doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility transmission owned by public utility.

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation
concepts.doc: Minimum amount of purchase arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from a supplier.

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, Due in Next Twelve Months
also: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
concepts.doc: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim …

concepts.label: Regulated and Unregulated Operating Revenue
concepts.doc: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

concepts.label: Regulatory Asset
concepts.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory asset as itemized in a table of regulatory assets as of the end of the period.

concepts.label: Regulatory Asset, Current
concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Such costs are capitalized if they meet …

concepts.label: Regulatory Asset, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are not expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle if longer.

concepts.label: Regulatory Liability
concepts.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory liability as itemized in a table of regulatory liabilities as of the end of the period.

concepts.label: Regulatory Liability, Current
concepts.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory current liability as itemized in a table of regulatory current liabilities as of the end of the period.

concepts.label: Regulatory Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory noncurrent liability as itemized in a table of regulatory noncurrent liabilities as of the end of the period.

concepts.label: Remaining Amounts of Regulatory Assets for which No Return on Investment During Recovery Period is Provided
also: Regulatory assets not expect to earn return
concepts.doc: Remaining balance of regulatory assets for which no return on investment during recovery is provided. In some cases, a regulator may permit an enterprise to include a cost that would be charged to expense by an unregulated enterprise as an …

concepts.label: Remaining Recovery Period of Regulatory Assets for which No Return on Investment During Recovery Period is Provided
also: Period for which expenditures are expected to be recovered
concepts.doc: Remaining recovery period of regulatory assets for which no return on investment during recovery period is provided, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

concepts.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
also: Repayment and repurchase of long-term debt
concepts.doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalent, Current
also: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent …

concepts.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current
also: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current, Total
concepts.doc: The current cash, cash equivalents and investments that are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against short-term borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with …

concepts.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
concepts.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

concepts.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
also: Operating revenue from contracts with customers
concepts.doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific …

concepts.label: Revenues
concepts.doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of …

concepts.label: Security Deposit
concepts.doc: The amount of an asset, typically cash, provided to a counterparty to provide certain assurance of performance by the entity pursuant to the terms of a written or oral agreement, such as a lease.

concepts.label: Segment Reporting, Other Segment Item, Amount
concepts.doc: Amount of other expense (income) and loss (gain) calculated as difference between segment revenue and separately disclosed expense category to arrive at segment profit (loss).

concepts.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period
concepts.doc: Period over which grantee's right to exercise award under share-based payment arrangement is no longer contingent on satisfaction of service or performance condition, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. …

concepts.label: Short-Term Debt
concepts.doc: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Short-Term Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

concepts.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
also: Issuance of stock to Dominion Energy
concepts.doc: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

concepts.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

concepts.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other
concepts.doc: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

concepts.label: Taxes, Miscellaneous
concepts.doc: All taxes not related to income of the entity or excise or sales taxes levied on the revenue of the entity that are not reported elsewhere. These taxes could include production, real estate, personal property, and pump tax.

concepts.label: Unbilled Receivables, Current
concepts.doc: Amount received for services rendered and products shipped, but not yet billed, for non-contractual agreements due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
concepts.doc: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
concepts.doc: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
concepts.doc: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

concepts.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
concepts.doc: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

concepts.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Purchases
concepts.doc: The amount purchased during the period under an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation (for example, under the take-or-pay or throughput contract).

concepts.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations
also: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations, Total
concepts.doc: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance, repairs and operations of regulated operation.

concepts.label: Variable Lease, Cost
concepts.doc: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted, Adjustment
also: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted, Adjustment, Total
concepts.doc: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
also: Average shares of common stock outstanding – Diluted
concepts.doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

concepts.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
also: Average shares of common stock outstanding – Basic
Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic, Total
concepts.doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been …
